name: Curve Vyper Reentrancy Exploits
description: A malfunctioning reentrancy lock in Vyper 0.2.15, 0.2.16 and 0.3.0 left every pool compiled with those versions open to reentrancy. Three ETH pools were drained within 716 blocks on 2023-07-30: JPEG'd pETH/ETH, Metronome msETH/ETH and Alchemix alETH/ETH. Each attack flash loaned WETH from the Balancer vault, entered through remove_liquidity, and re-entered the pool while its balances were mid-update. The msETH transaction was sent by 0xc0ffeebabe5d496b2dde509f9fa189c25cf29671, an operator widely reported as a whitehat who returned the funds. The Curve CRV/ETH pool was hit in the same campaign at blocks 17,807,830 and 17,808,683, outside this capture window.

key_transactions.description: Metronome msETH/ETH pool drained, about $3.4M, sent by c0ffeebabe and reported as a whitehat rescue
Alchemix alETH/ETH pool drained, about $22.6M, the largest single loss of the campaign

key_addresses.0xc0ffeebabe5d496b2dde509f9fa189c25cf296: c0ffeebabe.eth, sender of the msETH transaction
key_addresses.0xba12222222228d8ba445958a75a0704d566bf2: Balancer Vault (flash loan source for all three)
